references.text: Ajalon and Shaalbim are mentioned as part of the tribal inheritance of Dan, the same cities that the Amorites held onto in Judges 1:35
Shaalbim is listed as one of the cities in Solomon's second district, showing that the Israelites eventually gained control over this area
The Amorites are mentioned among the peoples God drove out for Israel, but who, according to Judges 1:35, managed to hold their ground in certain areas
A similar pattern where the Canaanites were put to forced labor (mas) instead of being completely driven out
The house of Joseph (Ephraim and Manasseh) put the Canaanites to forced labor when they became strong, using the same expression as in Judges 1:35
Summarizes the pattern where Israel put the local peoples to forced labor (mas) instead of driving them out
